notes: Printer start accepted on 2026-10-22 at 07:30:29 UTC; first observed stage RUNNING / Homing toolhead, before the first printed layer. Later camera captures show deposition in progress. At 12:27 UTC, fresh subscribe-only telemetry reported the same exact job RUNNING, 53%, layer 30/242, 243 minutes remaining, bed 55°C, print error 0 and no HMS entries. The remaining time is a live estimate; actual total duration and measured filament usage remain unknown. Monitoring was unobserved from approximately 08:57 to 10:30 UTC after the connector became unavailable; read-only MQTT and approved camera access recovered observation through a home worker. Current camera shows visible parts/supports seated without gross lifting or spaghetti in exposed areas; the toolhead occludes part of the rear. This does not establish quality, cleanup, fit, retention or strength, and first-layer adhesion was not retrospectively qualified. Human selected ONE full prototype V2 rotor concurrently with its fit fixture before physical trial acceptance; other two rotors remain held. Six objects share one ring arm and reuse the earlier numbered ring I only if intact. The blank cassette is non-electrical. Grey PLA, right nozzle external spool; textured plate, bed leveling and flow calibration enabled, AMS and timelapse disabled. Four walls, 30% gyroid, 0.10 mm layers / 0.20 mm first layer, 8 mm outer brim and normal snug supports. Physical support removal, fine-feature inspection, captive hardware fitting, lock return and full assembly remain unverified. Production guide deployment remains unverified; the human permitted local validated release without waiting for cloud publication.
